title: Anthropic IPO: Pricing Revealed
headline: Anthropic IPO
bill_title: THE COMPUTE BILL BEHIND THE GROWTH
caption:
Anthropic IPO: $70-78/sh, ~825M shares, $57.75B-$64.35B raised.
Valuation up to $1.40T. Seven tech giants pledged $26B; Alphabet and Nvidia $10B each.
Q3 revenue $16.956B (+1,127% y/y); compute & infra $9.863B; loss $0.567B.
Long-term commitments $90.09B. One page ↓
notes: Rebuild of a Futu NiuNiu / Graphic Finance card (chart dated 2026-11-11, citing Anthropic S-1/A amendment of 2026-11-10) into OPM format. Layout order follows the reference exactly: headline + kicker, four-column IPO terms panel, gold pledge ribbon overlapping the ranking panel, seven horizontal bars with company logos, four-column compute-bill panel, brand row + OPM footer. All Chinese labels translated to English; all amounts converted from 億/萬億 to $B/$T: $1.40萬億=$1.40T, 8.25億股=825M shares, $577.5億-$643.5億=$57.75B-$64.35B, $260億=$26B, $100億=$10B, $25億=$2.5B, $10億=$1B, $5億=$0.5B, $169.56億=$16.956B, $98.63億=$9.863B, $5.67億=$0.567B, $9,009億=$90.09B. Figures are reproduced from the supplied reference image, not independently re-verified. OPM rules: English only, no diagonal watermark, no Chinese, no QR/futu branding, unified footer. Per A-Ze 2026-11-14: only the LAYOUT follows the reference; colors do NOT. Final card is white-background OPM light theme with the approved orange/gold palette, dark ink for contrast, no dark background and no orange light bands. Round 3 (A-Ze 2026-11-14): top-right @onepagemarket pill replaced by the OPM wordmark image assets/opm-logo.png; two-line kicker and bottom-left brand row removed; freed space redistributed into larger vertical gaps and company logos enlarged from 42px to 56px diameter.
